title: Standard Enterprise Chart of Accounts for Digital Asset Payables

accounts.account_name: Cash and Cash Equivalents - Operating Bank
accounts.description: Primary corporate operating fiat bank accounts.

accounts.account_name: Digital Asset Treasury - USDC on Arc
accounts.description: Corporate smart contract and MPC-managed developer controlled wallets on Arc Testnet.
Standard trade payables liability booked against supplier purchase invoices.
Interim clearing ledger tracking on-chain permits before ERP writeback confirmation.

accounts.account_name: Cost of Goods Sold - Direct Supplier Materials
accounts.description: Inventory and direct materials booked from three-way matched purchase orders.
Arc network gas costs absorbed during ERC-20 approve and guard settlement transactions.
Sub-cent rounding variances arising from integer 6-decimal fixed-point conversions.

cost_centers.description: Treasury operations and on-chain payment execution overhead.

supplier_settlement.credit_account: 1120 - Digital Asset Treasury - USDC on Arc
supplier_settlement.rule: Exact supplier obligation discharge; debit equals credit.

network_fee_absorption.credit_account: 1120 - Digital Asset Treasury - USDC on Arc
network_fee_absorption.rule: Sum of all transaction stage receipts (approve_reset + approve + guard) rounded up to integer cents.
